info.title: x207 backend, marketplace and broker
info.description: Routes of the read API (spec 5a), the marketplace (5b to 5g), the settlement worker and the broker (5h). Generated by `scripts/build-openapi.mjs` from the sources; `test/api/openapi.test.ts` fails when a route and this document differ. Error codes are listed per status in `x-error-codes` and are what the route can answer, a little more than one request will. Response bodies are loose (`object`) except the error envelope and the page; the fields are in the spec of the vault. The backend answers errors as `{error: {code, message, details}}`; the broker as `{error, message}`. Limits against abuse (BE-066): 429 `rate_limited` with `Retry-After`, 413 `payload_too_large`, 409 `open_limit_reached`.
